Frontend.reason: Tracker Writing Correction now offers an optional deep-analysis mode that clearly costs two daily quota units. Learners can provide the exact task as text or a locally compressed image, receive a compact report tied to explicit prompt requirements and verbatim essay evidence, and see a clear refund message when recognition fails. All five managed-AI entry points now show quota consistently; daily suggestions, learning analysis and plan drafts also disable explicit generation while quota is loading, disabled or exhausted. Prepared plan text is filled into the editor instead of being submitted automatically.

Backend.reason: The companion Lexi branch adds backward-compatible writing submission V4 validation, server-side two-unit metering, multimodal routing and atomic two-unit refunds for failed prompt recognition or unsupported image routes. It stores only quota and request-receipt metadata; the prompt image, essay and report are not persisted in Supabase. Existing V2 and V3 writing submissions remain accepted.

Admin.reason: The companion Lexi Control branch adds purpose-specific writing policy controls for daily quota units, request bytes, output tokens and route selection, plus visible image-capability and refund semantics. Other Words and Tracker policy cards keep their existing behavior.

Deployment.reason: The coordinated Tracker, Lexi backend, Words and Control release is being verified locally. Production deployment is planned only after both repository release gates and cross-repository contract parity pass.

Verification.reason: Run Tracker typecheck, lint, tests and production build; then run the companion Lexi full-stack release gate and V2/V3/V4 cross-repository parity. Review quota states, deep-writing text and image inputs, and responsive Tracker and Control layouts without consuming an unnecessary production AI request.
